publicly_visible_components: preprint methods, figures, and supplementary-material references

blocking_components.requirement: Exact raw input dataset identifiers, versions, consent-access constraints, and checksums
Exact phased inputs, masks, ancestral-genome resources, genetic maps, and lifted coordinates
Exact Relate and SINGER versions, parameters, seeds, posterior samples, and converted tree-sequence checksums
Complete TRACE parameter matrix including focal times, posterior thresholds, physical-length thresholds, and genetic-distance thresholds
Processed segment calls and intermediate outputs with expected checksums
Environment lock covering Python, compiled dependencies, numerical libraries, and operating-system assumptions
Independent execution logs and comparison against reported figures, tables, ancestry proportions, and error metrics

minimum_independent_verification: rebuild or obtain pinned ARG inputs without silently changing masks or maps
run the published TRACE implementation at the pinned commit
reproduce known Neanderthal and Denisovan positive controls
reproduce negative controls and false-discovery estimates
reproduce ghost and super-archaic segment summaries
run at least one independent introgression method
record all outputs and SHA-256 digests
classify discrepancies rather than averaging them away
